status: Exploratory design-driven analysis; earlier outcomes and preliminary paired tables have been inspected. Not preregistration.
purpose: Complete the direct information audit before attributing a new substantive mechanism to the existing questionnaire.
enumeration: Examine every pair of the eight menus using instrument attributes only. Identify unchanged-service pairs, single-price-change pairs and single-rule-change pairs.
populations: each version separately for descriptive replication
primary_reporting: All mechanically eligible menu pairs; no selection by p-value. Whole-record paired covariance. Source labels unchanged.
swap_null: Conditional on stable individual utilities/tastes, independent task-level logit shocks and an unchanged pair of options, reverse two-task choice paths for those options have equal probabilities. Heterogeneous stable coefficients are integrated at the record level.
swap_multiplicity: Bonferroni across the two pooled instrument-eligible restrictions. Version and source results are exploratory diagnostics, not additional independent confirmations.
substitution_quantity: Net share decomposition for the single-price-change menu pair. It is not the fraction of named individuals causally switching, a real market elasticity, or a causal price effect with fixed task order.
context_sensitivity: State explicit hypothetical bounds on task-level log odds or probability drift; these bounds are assumptions, not estimated amounts of actual fatigue or framing.
novelty: Classical conditional-logit, paired-binomial, linear-contrast and Fieller constructions. No new framework name or independent theorem claim.
